item_summary: $150-200 dual-motor electric sit-stand desk frame with programmable memory presets and collision detection
detailed_item_draft: Procurement specification for a standalone electric sit-stand desk frame priced strictly between $150 and $200 USD. Must feature a dual-motor lifting system to ensure stability with a minimum load capacity of 150 lbs. Control interface must include a digital keypad with LED height readout and a minimum of 2 programmable memory presets for user height customization. Mandatory safety feature is an integrated anti-collision detection system that automatically halts and reverses motion upon sensing obstruction. Frame construction must be heavy-duty steel with a powder-coated finish, available in standard black or white. Height adjustment range must accommodate ergonomic sitting and standing positions (approximately 24 inches to 50 inches). Package includes standard wired controller and power supply but excludes the desktop surface. Product must be sold as a frame-only SKU with a minimum warranty of 1 year on motors and electronics.
